nom: Filorga Oxygen-Glow Super-Perfecting Radiance Daily Skin Cream, Hydrating Treatment with a Moisturizing Boost of Hyaluronic Acid and Detoxifying Enzymes for a Flawless, Wrinkle Free Face, 1.69 fl. oz.

avis.texte: This worked better than expected. I like the texture and scent. If you’re looking for a lot of moisturizing this isn’t for you. Although it’s a cream, it doesn’t offer a lot of emollience. Nonetheless, not bad overall.
For the first time I use cream and the result was fast and amazing.. Your face will glow after few days.
